description_en: Generates marketing copy based on the provided keywords, text length, and number of copy variations. Due to the complexities of the Chinese language, the length of the output text may differ from the requested length. After submitting the job, call the `GetSmartHandleJob` operation with the returned job ID to query the job status and retrieve the results
description_zh: 根据提交的关键词、字数、文案数，扩写出营销文案。由于中文的特殊性，输出文案字数可能跟需求字数有出入。提交任务成功后，根据JobId调用GetSmartHandleJob接口获取任务状态和结果
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-text-generate-job --title Test_title --description Test_description --type MarketingCopy --generate-config keywords_:_New_cake_shop,_animal_cream_,_textLength_:100,_targetCount_:3_or_originText_:_A_new_cake_shop_just_opened_on_the_street,_selling_cream_cakes,_fruit_cakes,_bread,_muffins,_etc._A_coffee_shop_opened_across_from_the_cake_shop,_with_a_steady_stream_of_customers. --user-data NotifyAddress_:_http://xx.xx.xxx_or_NotifyAddress_:_https://xx.xx.xxx_or_NotifyAddress_:_ice-callback-demo --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitTextGenerateJob

parameters.help_en:
The job title.

- The maximum length is 128 bytes.

- UTF-8 encoding is required
parameters.help_zh:
任务标题

- 长度不超过128字节。

- UTF8编码
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The job description, with a maximum length of 1,024 bytes (UTF-8 encoded)
parameters.help_zh: 任务描述，长度不超过1024字节（UTF8编码）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The job type.

Valid values:

`MarketingCopy`: Generates marketing copy.

`Title`: Generates a short video title.

`StoryboardScript`: Generates a storyboard script from text
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型

枚举值：
MarketingCopy：营销文案。
Title：短视频标题。
StoryboardScript：文案生成分镜脚本
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The generation configuration, in JSON format.

If `Type` is set to `Title` or `MarketingCopy`, specify the following fields:

`keywords`: The keywords used to generate the title or marketing copy. This parameter is required.

`textLength`: The target length of the generated text, in characters. Valid values: 5 to 1,000. The actual length of the output is less than or equal to this value. This parameter is required.

`targetCount`: The number of copy variations to generate. Valid values: 1 to 1,000. This parameter is required.

If `Type` is set to `StoryboardScript`, specify the following field:

`originText`: The original text used to generate the storyboard script. This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
生成配置。

Type = Title 或MarketingCopy时，需填写以下字段：
keywords：生成标题或营销文案的关键词。必填。
textLength：生成文案的字数，取值范围 5~1000。实际生成的文案字数可能略少于或等于此值，但不会超过。必填。
targetCount：生成的文案数量，取值范围 1~1000。必填。

Type = StoryboardScript 时，需填写以下字段：
originText：用于生成分镜脚本的原始文案，必填
parameters.name: generate_config

parameters.help_zh: 自定义设置，Json 格式，长度限制为 512 字节。支持https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451631.html
